subject.title: Fix QMD vector search timeout defaults

question: Should unconfigured QMD embedding use a 600-second timeout despite the longer write-lock and recovery budget, while preserving the existing `vsearch` score contract?
rationale: The timeout default is an upgrade-sensitive policy choice, and the proposed command substitution changes an established result-score boundary rather than only repairing a parser.

options.title: Preserve vector semantics and raise the default
options.body: Keep direct vector-search score behavior, rebase the timeout/default change, and add live proof plus focused compatibility coverage.

options.title: Adopt typed-query semantics deliberately
options.body: Accept the score-contract change only with explicit documentation, migration/compatibility behavior for `minScore`, and representative live evidence.

options.title: Split the work
options.body: Land only a narrowly proven parser or timeout repair, and track vector-command migration as a separately owned compatibility change.

recommendation.title: Preserve vector semantics and raise the default
recommendation.body: Keep direct vector-search score behavior, rebase the timeout/default change, and add live proof plus focused compatibility coverage.

likelyOwner.reason: Recent QMD-manager refactoring and repeated ownership signals make this the most likely person to decide the runtime boundary.
